label: Write
summary: Turn speech into clean text for the field focused when you choose Stop, with a saved recovery path when delivery is blocked.
proof: Local transcription is the default; optional shaping is a separate decision.

opening.title: Speak once. Stop at the field where your words belong.
opening.summary: Use Mumble’s deliberate Dictate command and speak while the Island shows what is happening. Keep or return focus to the intended field before you choose Stop. When Stop is requested, Mumble freezes that field as the destination. It then attempts one delivery.

demonstration.spoken: Move the design review to Thursday and send the notes before lunch.
demonstration.note: Illustrative cursor close-up—not a live transcription. The Mumble workspace above is a genuine product capture.

states.label: Choose cursor
states.title: Keep the intended field ready for Stop.
states.body: Place the cursor in the writing field where you want the finished text. Keep it focused, or return to it, before choosing Stop.

states.label: Speak
states.title: Mumble makes its state visible.
states.body: Use the global Dictate command and speak. Before choosing Stop, keep or return focus to the intended field. The Island shows Listening, then Transcribing.

states.label: Text returned
states.title: Stop freezes the intended destination.
states.body: When Stop is requested, Mumble freezes the focused field for one target-bound insertion. If delivery cannot complete, the result remains recoverable in the Deck.
states.field: Project note — Move the design review to Thursday and send the notes before lunch.

mechanism.title: One deliberate command. One visible route back.
mechanism.summary: Write keeps the Stop-time destination, processing state, privacy route, delivery attempt, and recovery path in one understandable sequence.

steps.title: Keep the intended field focused for Stop
steps.body: Place the cursor in a writable field. Keep or return focus to the intended field before you choose Stop. Mumble then uses the field focused at Stop instead of asking you to move into a separate editor.
steps.proof: The destination is frozen when Stop is requested—not when recording starts.

steps.title: Start with the deliberate global Dictate command
steps.body: Invoke Dictate from the application you are already using. The Island shows Listening, then Transcribing, so recording and processing are visible rather than implied.
steps.proof: The same global command starts and stops the dictation.

steps.title: Transcribe on this computer by default
steps.body: Local transcription is the default. Recorded audio stays on this computer unless the user explicitly selects Cloud transcription.
steps.proof: Optional shaping is a separate finished-text decision.

steps.title: Return once, or recover safely
steps.body: Mumble attempts to insert the finished text at the field frozen when Stop was requested. If insertion cannot complete, the result is saved in the Deck and History for Copy or Paste latest instead of being sent again automatically.
steps.proof: Later focus changes do not authorize a new destination or a second blind insertion.

tasks.title: Everyday notes
tasks.summary: Add a complete thought to the note already open in front of you.
steps: Place the cursor at the point where the note should continue.
Use the global Dictate command and speak the thought in ordinary language.
Keep or return focus to that field before you choose Stop; the Island then shows the transition into transcription.
Continue from the inserted text, or use the saved Deck result if delivery could not complete.

tasks.title: Longer text
tasks.summary: Draft a connected passage without replacing the document you already chose.
steps: Place the cursor in the draft where the next passage belongs.
Start Dictate and speak the passage at a comfortable pace.
Keep or return focus to that field before you choose Stop; the Island then shows the transition into transcription.
Review the returned text in the draft, or recover the finished result from the Deck if insertion was blocked.

tasks.title: Across applications
tasks.summary: Carry the same Write sequence into another writable desktop application.
steps: Open the destination application and place its cursor in the intended field.
Invoke the global Dictate command without leaving that application.
Speak, then keep or return focus to the intended field before you choose Stop.
Mumble attempts one return to the field frozen at Stop; if that field is unavailable at delivery, it keeps the text in the Deck rather than inserting elsewhere.

label: Capture
summary: Turn selected-microphone recordings and supported audio imports into durable, searchable working records.
proof: Mumble saves a private local recording before transcription; optional analysis uses transcript text, not the original audio.

opening.title: Turn a recording into a working record.
opening.summary: Record through the microphone selected in Mumble, or bring an existing WAV, MP3, FLAC, or OGG audio file. Mumble saves a private local recording first, then turns it into a record you can search, replay, and export.

demonstration.note: Genuine Mumble interface, shown with demonstration meeting data. This website does not use your microphone or pretend to record.

states.label: Choose source
states.title: Start with the selected microphone or accepted audio.
states.body: Use Mumble's selected microphone for a room recording, or import a WAV, MP3, FLAC, or OGG audio file. The app names the effective transcription route before capture begins.
states.alt: Genuine Mumble Meetings capture before recording, showing Record meeting, Import audio, the local transcription route, and the private meeting library

states.label: Record
states.title: Pause, resume, or Stop & save.
states.body: The live state shows elapsed time, bounded microphone level, the selected microphone, saved location, and transcription route. Pause and resume when needed; Stop & save finishes the durable recording before transcription.
states.alt: Genuine Mumble Meetings capture during recording, showing elapsed time, microphone input level, Pause, Stop and save, and the local context ledger

states.label: Find record
states.title: Search the saved library and keep working.
states.body: Search meeting titles and full transcripts in the local library. Open the original recording for playback, review the transcript, and export the record when it is ready.
states.alt: Genuine Mumble Meetings capture after recording, showing a searchable local meeting library with saved demonstration records

mechanism.title: Audio is saved first. The route stays visible.
mechanism.summary: Capture keeps the source, durable save, transcription route, local working record, and optional later actions in one understandable sequence.

steps.title: Choose the selected microphone or supported audio
steps.body: Record through the microphone selected in Mumble, with a visible elapsed time and controls to pause, resume, and Stop & save. Existing recordings can enter through WAV, MP3, FLAC, or OGG audio import.
steps.proof: Direct video import and computer-audio capture are not current input choices.

steps.title: Keep a private local recording
steps.body: Mumble writes microphone capture to a private local WAV while the meeting is running. Stop & save finishes that durable recording before transcription starts; imported audio is normalised into the same private meeting library first.
steps.proof: A failed or interrupted transcription does not silently discard a recording that was saved successfully.

steps.title: Choose Local or Cloud transcription explicitly
steps.body: Local transcription is the default and keeps meeting audio on this computer. Cloud transcription sends meeting audio to the deliberately selected configured provider after the route choice; the saved private local recording remains the working source.
steps.proof: The current effective route is shown before, during, and after capture.

steps.title: Search, replay, and review the record
steps.body: Search titles and full transcripts in the local meeting library, find matching transcript segments, and play the original recording in the computer's audio player. Best-effort speaker grouping can help review, but labels may need correction and can be less reliable for long or Cloud recordings.
steps.proof: Transcript search and playback are review tools; the screenshot data is a labelled demonstration.

steps.title: Export first; choose analysis separately
steps.body: Export a ready record as TXT, Markdown, JSON, HTML, or the clipboard. Summary, action-item, decision, and question tools remain optional and run only when a configured analysis route is available and you choose the action. The original recording is never sent for analysis.
steps.proof: Hosted analysis receives transcript text only; it is separate from the transcription route.

tasks.title: Meeting
tasks.summary: Keep a room conversation as a searchable record without pretending the website is a recorder.
steps: Open Meetings, confirm the selected microphone, saved location, and effective Local or Cloud transcription route.
Choose Record meeting. Use Pause and Resume when needed while the elapsed time and microphone level remain visible.
Choose Stop & save. Mumble finishes the private local recording before transcription begins.
Search the saved meeting, review or replay it, export the ready transcript, and choose optional analysis only when its route is available.

tasks.title: Lecture
tasks.summary: Capture a microphone lecture, then return to the exact part you need later.
steps: Select the room microphone in Mumble and check the effective transcription route before the lecture begins.
Record the lecture, pausing and resuming around breaks; current source limits one recording or import to four hours.
Stop & save so the private recording is durable before Mumble transcribes it through the selected route.
Search the transcript for a topic, replay the original recording in the computer's player, and export the ready record for your notes.

tasks.title: Existing recording
tasks.summary: Bring supported audio into the same local meeting library and review path.
steps: Choose Import audio and select a WAV, MP3, FLAC, or OGG recording of up to four hours.
Mumble normalises and saves a private local copy before background transcription begins.
The selected Local route keeps audio here; an explicit Cloud route sends audio to the configured transcription provider.
Search the completed transcript, play the saved recording, export the record, or choose optional transcript-only analysis when available.

label: Shape
summary: Give finished text a deliberate job, including Prompt, Email, Reply, and Deck actions.
proof: Cloud text shaping is optional and sends finished text—not recorded audio—through the chosen route.

label: Listen
summary: Read documents with saved progress, find, bookmarks, summaries, and optional voice playback.
proof: Provider-backed speech is an explicit online choice and may carry the provider's own cost.

label: Find
summary: Use Mumble Find to search local apps and files without hosted results entering the list.
proof: Web Search is separate and sends selected text online only after provider-named confirmation.
